reasoning: Five concrete actions named in the body: token exchange, profile fetch, user upsert, session cookie, redirect — each a single task.

children.title: Implement code-for-token exchange in callback handler
children.body:
Call Google's token endpoint with the authorization code; parse the access token and id token.

**Acceptance:**
- Token exchange succeeds for a valid code
- Errors surface ErrUpstream

children.title: Fetch user profile from Google with access token
children.body:
Call Google's userinfo endpoint with the token; parse the email, name, picture.

**Acceptance:**
- Returns ProfileResponse on success
- Returns ErrProfile on 401/403

children.title: Upsert local user record from Google profile
children.body:
Insert a new user or update the existing user keyed on email.

**Acceptance:**
- New email creates new user
- Existing email updates display name and picture

children.title: Establish session cookie
children.body:
Issue a signed session cookie referencing the user record.

**Acceptance:**
- Cookie is HTTP-only, Secure, SameSite=Lax
- 24-hour expiry; refresh-on-use

children.title: Redirect to post-login landing page
children.body:
On successful callback, 302 to /home (or the state-parameter-provided return URL).

**Acceptance:**
- Returning state URL is honored if same-origin
- Else /home
